room_rent.note: Co-payment on associated medical expenses (excl. pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics) if room rent exceeds entitled limit; co-payment not applicable for ICU admissions

icu.note: No co-payment applies for ICU room even if rent exceeds defined limit; paid at actual expenses

copayment.note: Mandatory 10% co-pay on all admissible hospitalisation bills (excl. pre/post-hosp). Optional additional 20% or 30% co-pay available for premium discount. Co-pay not applicable for modern treatment sub-limit procedures.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: 12 modern treatment procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, etc.) capped at 50% of SI per policy period

initial_waiting.note: Except accidental hospitalisation; not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: No reduction option mentioned; portability credit applicable as per IRDAI norms

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to 16 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or cap is mentioned in the schedule of benefits

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined capped at 2% of SI per hospitalisation

post_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined capped at 2% of SI per hospitalisation

day_care.note: Also covers any other procedures agreed by insurer requiring less than 24 hours hospitalisation due to technological advancement

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions (clause aa)

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered for accident and illness; preventive and rejuvenation treatments excluded

organ_donor.note: Donor screening, treatment and surgery to remove organs explicitly excluded; donor pre/post hospitalisation also excluded

ambulance.note: Ambulance is listed in Annexure 1 as a non-payable item

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures covered but capped at 50% of SI per policy period; co-payment waived for these procedures

consumables.note: Extensive list of consumables/non-medical items excluded in Annexure 1 (gloves, masks, etc.)

global_cover.note: Coverage restricted to India only; treatment outside India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, ambulance, OPD, maternity, organ donor, treatment outside India, stem cell storage, congenital external anomalies, dental (non-accidental)

optional_riders.display: Additional co-payment options (20% or 30%) for premium discount; no other riders mentioned
